context: Hi
Hello! I'm looking for a recommendation on a movie
What kind of movie are you looking for?
I really enjoy comedies and intriguing stories. I'm not a fan of horror or sci-fi
I would recommend the movie What We Do In the Shadows! It's a mockumentary about a group of vampires ��������� it's pretty funny and has an interesting story
that sounds interesting but I don't care for Vampire type movies, I consider those to be sci-fi. I really like a good plot, modern and relevant to what's happening in real life.
Hm, the movie The Meyerowitz Stories is pretty good, it's a comedy-drama about a somewhat estranged family being brought together because of their father's art show
That does sound interesting! I'm going to accept that recommendation, I'm really excited to watch it!
Great ��������� I hope you like it!
Do you have any other recommendations like that movie?
That movie stars Adam Sandler in a somewhat dramatic role, so I'd recommend another one of his more serious movies as well, like Uncut Gems or Punch-Drunk Love
I have never heard of those, I'll be sure to add those to my list. Thank you very much and I accept these recommendations! All of them!
Great! I think most of them are on Netflix as well!
Awesome, I'm a big netflix fan
50 First Dates is another I'd recommend
Do you have anything besides Adam Sandler movies?

Yeah, if you like comedies, I'd also recommend The Disaster Artist, it's a comedy based on the making of the movie The Room, which is widely regarded as one of the worst movies of all time. It's pretty funny!
That sounds interesting. Who are some of the actors in that movie?
James Franco, Dave Franco, and Seth Rogen
Is that movie on Netflix?
I think it's on European Netflix, but I'm not sure about US Netflix
Well that won't work for me.
Another I would recommend is Superbad, which I believe is on Netlifx
Okay - thank you very much. I will look for all of these movies!
